mechanism: Omeprazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing nafcillin levels, while nafcillin may induce CYP3A4 leading to reduced omeprazole efficacy.
action: Monitor clinical response to omeprazole; consider alternative antibiotic or PPI if reduced acid suppression is evident; no routine dose adjustment required but watch for nafcillin efficacy changes.
